title: Sections over the pullback of a split cover form a limiting fan of modules
statement: Let f:Y -> X be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let J be a finite set, possibly empty, V_j schemes, i_j:V_j -> Y clopen immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] forming a colimit cofan, and t_j:X -> V_j satisfy t_j ; i_j ; f = id_X and i_j ; f ; t_j = id_V_j. Put s_j=t_j ; i_j. For a sheaf H of modules over a commutative ring Lambda on the small etale site of Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and an etale W -> X, the fan in ModuleCat(Lambda) with vertex H(W times_X Y) [def-pc-fibre-product] and legs H(sigma_j,W), where sigma_j,W is the pullback lift of id_W and W -> X -> Y via s_j, is a limiting fan. This statement is at a fixed W and asserts neither naturality in W nor an isomorphism of sheaves.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] and uniqueness of coproducts to obtain pairwise disjoint clopen images covering Y from hcolim. *The pieces of $W\times_XY$.* Fix an object $w:W\to X$ of $X_{\Et}$ and write $W_Y=W\times_XY$ with projections $p:W_Y\to W$, $q:W_Y\to Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product]; $(W_Y,q)$ is the object of $Y_{\Et}$ at which $f_*H$ is evaluated (the pullback evaluation object). Put $O_j=q^{-1}(V_j)$. Since the $V_j$ are pairwise disjoint, open and closed and cover $Y$, the $O_j$ ($j\in J$) are pairwise disjoint, open and closed and cover $W_Y$; if $J=\varnothing$ then $Y=\varnothing$ and $W_Y=\varnothing$. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] (with base $X$, the open $W\subseteq W$, the open $V_j\subseteq Y$, $U=X$) the canonical morphism $W\times_XV_j\to W_Y$ is an open immersion with image $p^{-1}(W)\cap q^{-1}(V_j)=O_j$, compatibly with the projections; the projection $W\times_XV_j\to W$ is the base change along $w$ of the isomorphism $f|_{V_j}:V_j\to X$, hence an isomorphism (its inverse is $(\mathrm{id}_W,(f|_{V_j})^{-1}\circ w)$, by the universal property [def-pc-fibre-product]). So $p|_{O_j}:O_j\to W$ is an isomorphism of schemes from the open subscheme $O_j$. Now $\sigma_{j,W}=(\mathrm{id}_W,s_j\circ w)$ satisfies $p\circ\sigma_{j,W}=\mathrm{id}_W$ and $q\circ\sigma_{j,W}=s_j\circ w$, which lands in $V_j$; so $\sigma_{j,W}$ maps $W$ into the open $O_j$, hence factors through the open subscheme $O_j$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and the factored morphism is a right inverse of the isomorphism $p|_{O_j}$, hence equal to its inverse. Thus $\sigma_{j,W}$ is an open immersion with image $O_j$ (an isomorphism $W\xrightarrow{\sim}O_j$ followed by the inclusion). The morphism $s_j\circ w:W\to Y$ is etale ($s_j$ is an open immersion, hence etale, and $w$ is etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1), (2)), so $W_j:=(W,s_j\circ w)$ is an object of $Y_{\Et}$, $\sigma_{j,W}:W_j\to(W_Y,q)$ is a morphism of $Y_{\Et}$ (as $q\circ\sigma_{j,W}=s_j\circ w$) and is etale (open immersion), and the family $\{\sigma_{j,W}:W_j\to W_Y\}_{j\in J}$ is jointly surjective (the $O_j$ cover $W_Y$), so it is a covering of $W_Y$ in $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] (the empty family when $J=\varnothing$, which covers $W_Y=\varnothing$).

proof.text: Apply the sheaf equalizer condition in the coefficient category of modules to this covering. For unequal indices the overlap is empty and H(empty) is zero by the empty cover. For equal indices the overlap projections agree because sigma is monic. Every family is compatible and therefore glues uniquely. For any module M and linear maps from M to the section modules on the sheets, glue their values elementwise. Uniqueness of gluing shows the glued assignment is additive and Lambda-linear; uniqueness also proves the universal property for this fan. The same argument for empty J makes H(W times_X Y) terminal. These are precisely the existence and uniqueness clauses of IsLimit.

theorem splitCoverSectionsLimit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type w} [Finite J]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y)
    (t : ∀ j, X ⟶ V j)
    (hcolim : IsColimit (Cofan.mk Y i))
    (hinv₁ : ∀ j, t j ≫ i j ≫ f = 𝟙 X)
    (hinv₂ : ∀ j, i j ≫ f ≫ t j = 𝟙 (V j))
    (hopens : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion (i j))
    (hclosed : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (i j))
    (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (W : X.Etale) :
    letI : ∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) := hopens
    letI : ∀ j, IsIso (t j) := fun j ↦
      ⟨⟨i j ≫ f, hinv₁ j, hinv₂ j⟩⟩
    let s := fun j ↦ t j ≫ i j
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk
      (H.obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)))
      (fun j ↦ H.obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
        (A := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale (s j))).obj W)
        (B := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)
        (pullback.lift (𝟙 W.left) (W.hom ≫ s j)
          (by
            change (𝟙 W.left) ≫ W.hom = (W.hom ≫ s j) ≫ f
            simp [s, Category.assoc, hinv₁ j]))
        (by simp)).op)))
